title: Xtra Power BRUSHLESS ANGLE GRINDER Disc Diameter : 100MM (XPC-AG-01)
description: The XPC AG 01 Brushless Angle Grinder is a powerful 100 mm cutting and grinding tool designed for demanding metalworking and construction applications. Featuring advanced brushless motor technology, this angle grinder delivers superior performance with increased efficiency, longer runtime, and extended tool life compared to traditional brushed motors. The 100 mm disc size makes it ideal for a wide range of tasks including cutting metal, grinding welds, removing rust, and smoothing surfaces. The brushless design ensures consistent power delivery whilst reducing maintenance requirements, as there are no carbon brushes to replace. This compact yet robust grinder is engineered for both professional tradespeople and serious DIY enthusiasts who require reliable performance on the job site. The ergonomic design allows for comfortable handling during extended use, whilst the tool's construction ensures durability in challenging work environments. Whether you're working with steel, aluminium, or other metals, this angle grinder provides the power and precision needed to complete your projects efficiently.
